WebKit.framework.role: Out-of-process web rendering engine coordinating UIProcess viewport interactions and WebProcess DOM layout

WebKitLegacy.framework.role: In-process legacy DOM rendering components providing WebActionDisablingScrollView

responsibilities: Receives physical touch and pointer events from WindowServer/BackBoardServices
Executes UIKit pan gesture recognition and inertial physics on the UI runloop
Updates CALayer CATransform3D transforms asynchronously on the scrolling thread without waiting for DOM reflow
Sends viewport commit transactions to WebProcess via IPC Mach messages
Parses HTML, CSS, and executes JavaScript runtimes (JavaScriptCore)
Maintains the DOM tree, CSS layout boxes, and RenderLayers
Renders visual content into raster tile surfaces
Processes passive and active JavaScript scroll/wheel event listeners

ivars.name: _internalDelegate
ivars.description: Internal delegate forwarding scroll notifications to RemoteScrollingCoordinatorIOS

ivars.name: _externalDelegate
ivars.description: App-provided developer delegate receiving standard UIScrollViewDelegate callbacks

ivars.name: _scrollingTreeScrollingNode
ivars.description: Pointer to the UIProcess asynchronous scrolling tree node managing layer transform updates

overridden_methods.behavior: Forwards programmatic offset to both UIScrollView superclass and ScrollingTreeScrollingNodeIOS; dispatches commit transaction to WebProcess
Maintains split delegate pattern ensuring internal WebKit telemetry cannot be broken by external app delegate assignment
Coordinates pan gesture recognizer against text selection, link taps, and double-tap zoom gestures on WKContentView

remote_scrolling_coordinator.role: Master synchronization bridge between WebProcess layout tree and UIProcess scrolling tree

methods.description: Requests CADisplayLink callback on UIProcess runloop matching display refresh rate (120Hz on ProMotion)
Returns current contentOffset from ScrollingTreeScrollingNodeIOS with sub-pixel floating-point precision
Flushes accumulated scrolling tree changes across IPC channel to WebProcess

node_types.role: Root viewport node managing main web page scrolling, rubber-banding, and page scale zoom
Sub-viewport node managing CSS overflow:scroll and overflow:auto elements

asynchronous_transform_pipeline: 1. Touch event arrives at UIProcess WindowServer port
2. WKScrollView pan gesture recognizer updates contentOffset
3. ScrollingTreeScrollingNodeIOS receives updated offset on the main/scrolling thread
4. Node immediately mutates CALayer sublayerTransform: CATransform3DMakeTranslation(-offset.x, -offset.y, 0)
5. CoreAnimation commits layer tree to GPU compositor at 120Hz ProMotion without waiting for WebProcess
6. Synthetic scroll event is dispatched asynchronously via IPC to WebProcess for DOM onscroll dispatch

auto.scroll_chaining: Enabled (Boundary overscroll propagates to parent scroll views or system shell)

contain.rubber_band_bounce: Enabled locally on the scrolling container
contain.scroll_chaining: Disabled (Overscroll momentum cannot bubble up to parent scrolling containers)

none.rubber_band_bounce: Disabled (Boundary offset is strictly clamped to [minOffset, maxOffset]; rubberBandOffset returns 0.0)
none.scroll_chaining: Disabled (Boundary overscroll is fully suppressed; no bubbling to parent viewports)

active_listeners.behavior: Blocks asynchronous scrolling thread while waiting for JavaScript event.preventDefault() call
active_listeners.timeout_action: If WebProcess fails to respond within 100ms, UIProcess drops listener block and resumes asynchronous scrolling

passive_listeners.behavior: Never blocks scrolling; UIProcess applies layer transforms immediately at 120Hz and dispatches DOM wheel events asynchronously via IPC

event_coalescing.coalescing_formula: Accumulates deltaX and deltaY across frame intervals, emitting a single coalesced IPC event per display refresh cycle

coverage_tiers.visible: Retained in active IOSurface backing stores at 120Hz
coverage_tiers.preload_coverage: Secondary pre-rasterized tiles (1 viewport height lookahead); marked volatile under level 1 memory pressure
coverage_tiers.non_visible: Evicted immediately and backing IOSurfaces reclaimed under level 2 critical OOM

oom_fallback.uiprocess_behavior: Displays background color or checkerboard fallback surface until WebProcess re-rasterizes newly visible tiles
